scope: Current local synthetic internal Question Platform build
method: Simulated expert review from source inspection, deterministic tests, and JSDOM rendering. No browser, assistive-technology, or human execution.

scores.finding: Workflow names, blockers, safe data boundaries, and recovery text are generally explicit, but selected-record identity can be wrong.
Landmarks, headings, panels, context, and tables are structured, while many rendered component classes have no styling.
Consistent templates help, but 17 top-level destinations and dense authoring controls need grouping and browser validation.
All workflows are named in navigation, but mobile discovery relies on a conflicting horizontal navigation strip.
Filters and direct cross-links exist, but no shortcuts, bulk operations, durable views, or server-scale navigation exist.
Revision hashes, blocked commands, and release gates are strong, but expired evidence can leave editorial decisions enabled.
Sixteen explicit fixtures include owners and remedies, but action feedback and focus can be cleared by rerender and drafts lack durable recovery.
Synthetic boundaries and protected-data limits are explicit, but source, inventory, privacy, and transcript selection can drift.
Rendering patterns are consistent, but missing CSS selectors and mixed read-only versus active controls weaken system consistency.
Two breakpoints and table scrolling exist, but mobile navigation state conflicts and no browser matrix was executed.
The base palette is restrained and work-focused, but core components are unstyled and no visual execution was available.
Landmarks, names, live regions, native controls, and focus targets are present, but focus continuity, contrast, browser, and AT evidence remain open.
Native controls are keyboard-capable, but 17 navigation tab stops, rerender focus loss, and no complete keyboard run limit efficiency.
IDs, hashes, claims, roles, assignments, and gate states are visible, but visual styling and natural state paths are incomplete.
The UI exposes lineage fields, but selected inventory, source, transcript, privacy, and rights data are not reliably joined.

current_findings: All 17 workflows rendered in deterministic local synthetic DOM simulation.
All 16 required state fixtures rendered with focus, recovery, and synthetic-boundary metadata.
Selected-record lineage is unsafe across inventory, source, privacy, and transcript workflows.
Expired evidence is omitted from editorial control eligibility.
Core rendered components lack CSS selectors.
Action feedback and focus continuity are not stable across rerenders.
Real browser, assistive-technology, and human validation are absent.
changes: No product change. Scorecard documentation only.
risks: Wrong source context can undermine reviewer decisions.
An expired-evidence contradiction can invite an invalid decision attempt.
Unverified responsive and accessibility behavior can exclude required operators.
blockers: Pass real browser, accessibility, and human validation.
root_handoff: Keep the simulated UX gate red. Repair P0 issues, execute browser and human protocols, then commission an independent rescore.
